reviews.author: Jon Harol
reviews.text: I got a little too confident playing weekend cowboy, and got the Lowe’s rental truck stuck in my backyard. Josh came out and saved me in 30 minutes. Thanks!

reviews.author: Chris Tilley
reviews.text: My car died two Fridays ago, as soon as I turned out of my company's driveway onto a main road (it was around 5:00 pm). I called AAA and they put me in the queue. The first ETA I got was 8:00 pm; later they changed it to 10:00 pm. They wanted me to wait FIVE hours to be towed TWO miles - no way. I called R&R Towing; Josh was there in fifteen MINUTES. Super-friendly, super-helpful, got my car where it needed to be. Next time I'm calling R&R first!!!

reviews.author: Alex Blackmon
reviews.text: R&R towing is top of the line, best of the best around. I called them on a Friday after lunch time with a machine down needing it towed to Raleigh by 5pm and they made it happen! Eric and Tony showed up and got right to work, carefully getting my broke machine loaded up. They were both very professional and respectful hard working guys

reviews.author: B Graduate
reviews.text: Excellent experience today with Josh helping me trade my 15 year old dead Subaru in. Car was dead in the garage and on a trickle charge meter for about 4 hours before Josh came with the tow truck. Car initially didn't even start at all when we took the charger off but Josh had the serious jump starter in the tow truck and we ended up getting it out and on the lift pretty easily. Came on time and got me to where I needed to go flawlessly. Would recommend. Thanks again.

reviews.author: Jedidiah “Pickles” Brandt
reviews.text: I called on a Sunday afternoon, and R&R had the best price and best time to come help me. Josh was very communicative and utterly a pleasure to coordinate with.

reviews.author: Katelyn Armstrong
reviews.text: If I could give this business 10 stars, I would. Let me break it down for you. It’s Saturday morning and we were all packed and ready to go camping. Except we live on the gnarliest hill of all time and it rained all morning. Needless to say, we weren’t able to pull our truck or our camper out of the mud pit that we found ourselves in. After about 3 hours of trying ourselves, a trip to Ace hardware for gravel, neighbors offering us wood and ramps to help us out, NOTHING was working. I called R&R towing and they had Josh to us in 15 minutes. Getting the truck out was no problem, but the truck AND the camper??? I thought nobody but God himself could do it but Josh pulled us out within minutes. And I was ready to sell my soul to the devil after the entire morning trying on our own to get out but the fee was SO reasonable. Shoutout to R&R & especially Josh for saving our 4 year olds birthday camping trip!

reviews.author: Blake Minear
reviews.text: I believe he worked late last night and I woke him up this morning when my truck broke down. It was friendly courteous did a wonderful job grateful he was there when I needed him five stars at least.

reviews.author: Joe Palko
reviews.text: Had Josh come hook my jeep up, exceptional customer service and care while putting it on the truck. Communication was awesome knew exactly when to expect them and let me know once my jeep was dropped off at the dealership.

reviews.author: Veronica Guzman
reviews.text: Requested tow service and they responded quickly. Josh was very helpful and courteous. Appreciate the assistance I received for the R&R Team. Thank you.

reviews.author: Tanner Lassiter
reviews.text: Superior customer service and great conversation is hard to come by these days. Thank you Chuck for delivering both of those today for us! Went the extra mile and made sure we were taken care of.

reviews.author: David Ramsubhag
reviews.text: Made a mistake and originally called a "scam" towing company. After realizing this (and getting my refund) I called R&R and instead of waiting 4 hours Josh was there in 20 minutes. Josh was quick and professional. He helped get my car with locked front axles up smoothly and took good care of my vehicle. Great company!

reviews.author: Courtney Beickert
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about R & R Towing. From the moment I called, their customer service was friendly, professional, and reassuring. My car broke down unexpectedly, and they had a driver, Josh, out to me within 30 minutes. Josh was incredibly kind and knowledgeable, he made a stressful situation feel a lot more manageable. He gladly towed the car to the shop we requested and dropped the key in the drop box for us! If you're ever in need of a tow, I highly recommend R & R Towing. They are fast, reliable, and genuinely great people to work with!

reviews.author: Karen A
reviews.text: Had a great experience with R & R Towing - called right after 5p and a gentleman answered the phone promptly - I gave him a bit of info and he said he would have the driver call me back. Tony (the driver) called within minutes and confirmed details with me, we discussed the price (reasonable) and coordinated him picking up the vehicle. Tony was great - he called after he delivered the vehicle to the auto repair shop to update me (he even placed the keys in the drop-box for me :)) - it was just a great experience from start to finish. When your vehicle breaks down it's already a stressful event and you are just hoping for one thing to go right....and let me tell you R & R Towing took the stress right off of me by handling my request quick and efficiently. Would highly recommend to anyone and if they are in need of a tow. Thank you again so much Tony!!!

reviews.author: Michael Staszewski
reviews.text: I needed to have my truck towed for service. I called today and Josh came out soon after, got me hooked up, and gave me a lift to the dealership. He did a great job and was in good spirits despite his failed Fantasy Football season.

reviews.author: Jamie Barefoot
reviews.text: As a normal thing I don't write reviews because I believe that in doing business you should always do what's right regardless. But when a person goes above and beyond this should be noted. On Monday (6/9/2025) around 9pm at night my son was need of an immediate tow for his car and when we call R/R towing and told him what type of car he had he immediately knew what type of wrecker to bring. He was there within 15 min. He looked at the vehicle and took the time to troubleshoot and look at the angles and do what would cause the least damage. He did not have to do this!! He was quick efficient and above else a human being. I am noting the time and date due to the fact that I do not remember who the driver was but I hope records will show this and he will have a shout at the very least!! I so do appreciate the kindness and consideration he showed us and I if and when I ever need a wrecker in the future I will be calling R/R!! Thank you again for doing business the right way the first time..

reviews.author: Chris Barnette
reviews.text: Nobody likes to have to call the tow company but Josh arrived quickly and with good humor. He worked efficiently and treated us with great respect like old friends. Highly recommend R and R and also Josh!

reviews.author: Dave Matthews
reviews.text: My daughter's car died. R and R was very helpful. They communicated effectively and let me know where they were and when I could expect them. Josh, the driver, was great. He hooked up quickly and towed it to the mechanic. And I enjoyed talking to him on the ride. Great guy! They made a bad situation a little less painful.

reviews.author: Phil Ronaghan
reviews.text: Awesome, and quick service. Josh was a life saver, as I was stuck in a disabled vehicle at a busy intersection. He was a real professional who did his job efficiently and with a friendly manner. Thanks Josh!

reviews.author: Juniper Isley
reviews.text: Josh was our driver. He showed up so quickly and was friendly and professional. Got my truck to where it needed to go in a timely manner, and was overall one of the best tow truck drivers I’ve ever had!!

reviews.author: susan beasley
reviews.text: R&R was very responsive. I called on a Sunday afternoon, the driver called me back within 5 minutes and came directly to my house. He was very pleasant and professional when loading up the vehicle and called me when he dropped the car at the dealership to let me know he got it where it belonged

reviews.author: Levi Shenk
reviews.text: I put one of my front tires in a ditch trying to back out of a driveway, and Tony made it out in under an hour. He got the car out of the ditch without any trouble or additional damages, and was freindly the whole time. Could not have asked for more from a towing company.

reviews.author: Xavier Parrott
reviews.text: Work truck went down on us at a job site so we called R&R. Josh was responsive and got the vehicle within 30 minutes of my call. Very professional and helpful. Thanks again for you help R&R.

reviews.author: Casey N
reviews.text: Josh is an amazing worker, he helped me out within 30 to 45 minutes and got the my truck to shop after waiting for AAA for about 5 hours. Definitely recommend for any vehicle/roadside assistant!

reviews.author: Tanya Johnson
reviews.text: Our 1953 chevy truck broke down. Called and Josh was very quick to get us hooked up and home. Very personable and friendly. Great customer service. Will definitely refer R&R Towing. Thank you. Dan and Tanya Johnson

reviews.author: Brandon Smith
reviews.text: I ran into a last minute issue with my vehicle where the clutch went out and it was undrivable. I called R&R around 11pm that night and spoke to the manager about the situation. He said his team could take care of it and if I needed a tow immediately or the following morning. I confirmed that the service was needed the following morning. I called the office at 8am sharp and same manager answered my call and let me know that one of his guys will be reaching - of whom eventually was Tony. Tony provided great timely service and was able to get my vehicle from Fuquay to Cary on a wet rainy day with a positive attitude. I would recommend this towing company to any one in need of towing services in the area.

reviews.author: B F (LAWN-BOY NC)
reviews.text: Mike at R&R Towing was great. He spotted us on the side of 440 waiting for another tow company. The other company was going to be at least 4 hours. Mike took care of us in less than 20 minutes. I would recommend to anyone in need of fast response.

reviews.author: Tera Krammes
reviews.text: I needed my 2020 Dodge Journey pulled from a muddy pit at 01: 30 AM on a red clay road. R & R came through. In less than 30 minutes, Josh picked me up and pulled my vehicle free. I had called around and everyone else either said no, not this late, or I got voicemail. Mike gave me a reasonable quote and were honest decent guys. The Josh even waited for me to get to the main paved ensuring I would not face any more issues. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Taylor Michelle
reviews.text: My tire blew and I needed a tow. Josh was very quick and efficient. He only took about 30 minutes to get to me. I would definitely recommend anyone to use this company!

reviews.author: Michael Webber
reviews.text: They saved my bacon. Was in an unsafe spot during commuter traffic and they did all they could to get to me quickly, when no one else would even respond. Driver Josh was amazing! Great service. Highly reccomend .

reviews.author: Jazzercise Garner
reviews.text: Chase has helped us out a few times and is always personable and professional. His work speaks for itself so if you need a tow, this is the company to call! Arlene D

reviews.author: Daphne Wright
reviews.text: My classic car broke down and R&R Towing was more than carefull with getting it back to my house. He even helped push it into the garage. Dispatch was excellent, and cannot say enough about Josh M the tow truck driver. He was super nice, skilled and careful with my car. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: ME H
reviews.text: Yesterday husbands truck broke down and we had it on the side of the road trying to get it to the auto shop. Called a few towing companies but most couldn’t get to it until the next day. But not R&R! They came to our aid in only 20 min from calling. Got it to the auto shop and even maneuvered it around for the auto shop people. Would highly recommend this is company, very fast and responsive, skilled drivers and reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Marcelle Riley
reviews.text: Today was the first time I’ve used R and R Towing and they are an amazing business. Everyone from the dispatcher to the wrecker driver were great. They were professional and very personable. My kind of people. I highly recommend them. I will not be using anyone else!

reviews.author: Shell
reviews.text: My daughter was stuck in ditch due to the rain and bad driving skills. Bill with R & R Towing came and towed her out without any problems. He was very pleasant and took great care of her and her car. I am so grateful for Bill and R & R Towing for their service. I would recommend them to anyone please call them for help.

reviews.author: Phyllis Arsenault
reviews.text: My daughter was stranded for hours on the side of the road, waiting for a different tow truck to come,, I called R and R and Mike was there within 20 minutes and saved the day for her!! He made it very easy and got her car safely to mechanics and she is now safe at home!! Many thanks Mike!! Bless you!!

reviews.author: Andrew Erdman
reviews.text: Broke down on the side of New Hill Holleman…R&R was my 1st phone call. I got someone right away and he explained in detail what equipment was needed for my tow and he was honest about having two cars in front of me before getting to me. Dispatch gave me a time frame of approximately 3 hrs. Not long after, the driver checked in to confirm details of the pickup. He got to me within the provided time frame. He delivered my car to my mechanic and called to get my info for payment. The entire experience was very well communicated and I was never left wondering what was going on. They will always get my business for tow needs! Well done R&R

reviews.author: Mark Williams
reviews.text: Today I was in need of having my vehicle towed from a local body shop to the Lincoln dealership. Chase came to the body shop within 30 minutes and was more than willing to help me since Mike's tow refused to move the vehicle because it was in bay. Chase without an issue got it to the dealership without any issues. He as very professional and kind young man. Thanks for your help Chase. I strongly recommend R&R towing for needs.

reviews.author: Sh4ron C
reviews.text: I had a car accident recently and they took my car there. Terrible customer service. The man who answered the phone hung up on me twice and treated me as if I weren’t a human being. The worst experience I’ve had in my life.

reviews.author: David L
reviews.text: Called R & R for a winch out when my vehicle was stuck in mud by the side of the road. Even though it was the middle of the night, the truck arrived within 25 minutes and the driver, Josh, was a pleasure to work with.

reviews.author: jacob nelson
reviews.text: I used this company under referral. My first experience was not bad, prices were reasonable and service was what you would expect from a tow truck company. I called back on what I guess they considered to be a holiday to set up for two more vehicles to get towed. Half way though explaining what I was requesting of them the person who had taken my call said call back tomorrow and hung up on me. I have taken my business else where and would recommend you do the same. Anyone willing to turn down good reliable repeat business like I was offering in such a rude manner doesn't deserve to be in business. This company survives off of the crashes on 55 I would not trust them to do something other than chase ambulances.

reviews.author: Pleshette Booker
reviews.text: My cheap bone made me call around before putting my tail between my legs and calling back for a tow after midnight. The guy who answered the phone either remembered me or had caller I D, and said the driver would get up with me. He called, came in no time, tried to help get it started, towed and parked the truck in the yard. No problem

reviews.author: Dharmesh Kharva
reviews.text: I needed a tow truck quickly. I scheduled another company earlier but they cancelled at last minute. Zack showed up quickly after I called R&R. He tried to jump the car in case. It didn't start. Then he carefully and skillfully loaded up my car onto the flatbed. I paid $100 with a credit card. $15 more than my previous quote from the tow truck that didn't show up. We met up at Honda service. Zack everything went fine and delivered the key. My only regret is that I didn't call R&R earlier.

reviews.author: Anne Hollowell
reviews.text: We called R&R Towing for a wench job after my mom accidentally drove over a wooden barrier log in a parking lot. Josh was very professional, efficient and kind, reassuring my tearful mother and quickly getting her back on the road at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: George Pentland
reviews.text: I called R&R Towing to pick up my 1966 f-100 that had broke down. The driver (Billy) called to inform me he was at another call, but would get to me next. He was there within 1 hour. I have AAA but call R&R instead because their fast reliable service and the care they take when towing a vehicle

reviews.author: Ethan Dennis
reviews.text: I couldn't recommend R & R Towing out of Fuquay more. Mike B arrived fast despite being at another job when I called, was very good at quickly loading the car, and even gave me a ride home before taking my car to the shop. If in the area, please utilize R & R Towing.

reviews.author: Shelsia Hunsinger
reviews.text: R&R towing is amazing! Tonight I was in my very first wreck. JT showed up very fast within about 20 minutes of me calling. As soon as he arrived, he explained the whole process to me on how to get things taken care of. Very good communication and fast service! Thank you R&R towing!

reviews.author: M. Moseley Matheson
reviews.text: Great experience! Called on a Saturday, person who answered was friendly and easy to work with. Driver showed up quickly and called ahead to let me know when to expect him. He was quick at getting my truck loaded, get me to my mechanic and was able to get my big truck unloaded in a tight spot! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Willet On Kinnakeet
reviews.text: Josh was the best! He was able to get to us so quickly (even late on a Saturday night) and was so calm, kind, and helpful!

reviews.author: Donald Mitchell
reviews.text: Josh at R&R towing very respectful and professional. R&R towing I can say is a company that won’t let you down.

reviews.author: Ryan Neely
reviews.text: Billie was great. Nice attitude, showed up promptly, educated me on what he would be doing-and then he completed the service. 5 star rating is the least they can get. Overall great experience.

reviews.author: Jeniffer Klohr
reviews.text: Super nice!! Very helpful! I was in the process of jumping off my other car when he came to tow my mother's car and I turned around he was charging my car, I got in turned her on and she was purring like a kitten! He continued to get my mother's car ready and he towed it to I fix ford's. I would highly recommend this company!! It's wonderful to meet nice people!

reviews.author: AYMAN IBRAHIM
reviews.text: If I can do ZERO star I will do it, they are froud just taking cash and charge you 200$ for 100 feet moving!!!

reviews.author: Wes
reviews.text: From my small experience with the owners I can tell they are extremely kind people! In the chic-fil-a line today I was informed that the person in front of me purchased my food. I found their business through their R&R Towing license plate to leave this review for them, but I just wanted to say to them we greatly appreciate the kindness they gave us today!

reviews.author: Ronald Lsssiter
reviews.text: I contacted this company to position a 5th wheel RV on a lot. The driver Chuck was amazing at positioning the RV. This company has a great driver in Chuck and their equipment is top notch I recommend them to all my friends.

reviews.author: Meaghan
reviews.text: Well I just got off of the phone with Daniel, the OWNER of R & R Towing. I called to report the reckless driving of one of his employees that almost caused multiple accidents this morning. While I was slowing up at redlight on the corner of N. Main St & Sportmanship Way in Holly Springs, I was suddenly taken by surprise as one his tow trucks with an extremely long bed was NOT slowing/yielding to the red light like everyone else. He came flying up on the right side of my vehicle almost hitting me and my CHILDREN as I was trying to get them to school. He forced me to quickly maneuver over to the left lane in steadily moving traffic, again as everyone is trying to yield to the red light. His driver proceeded on recklessly whipping this long bedded truck around the traffic and did a u- turn where he parked at a car that had been wrecked and had 1 police car sitting at what had obviously been a crash. HOWEVER, this wasn’t an emergency situation as there were no emergency lights on the police car, no ambulance, and no fire trucks, and no others at the site. All the while, I am laying on my horn. He scared me! He scared my kids and I sure many others! While making his u- turn, his driver blew a kiss at me and & laughed. When he parked… he noticed me taking pictures of this with my phone… I yelled, “ What is wrong with you, I am reporting you.” He yelled and said, “When you see my truck GET OUT OF THE WAY!”.. I called the company of course. I didn’t get an answer but then Daniel immediately called back. I attempted to tell him why I was calling. He rudely kept cutting me off asking me to “describe the tuck.” I did. After finally struggling through MULTIPLE times of him RUDELY cutting me off, he automatically jumps defensive & proceeded to tell me, “ You don’t know what/where he was going and if it was an emergency or not!” I told him, “ I do know where he was going, I saw the wrecked vehicle and the police officer sitting there.” He then said, “But regardless I will say something to him because he shouldn’t have been acting that way.” Not only is his driver reckless and unprofessional, I found Mr. Daniel to be defensive, unprofessional, uncaring of my complaint and the safety hazard his driver posed to me, my kids, or the other drivers , and extremely rude!

reviews.author: Tania Arce
reviews.text: Let me 1st say , I am impressed with this company. Quick service and friendly drivers. Alex was a dream to work with. Very understanding and always with a smile! If I ever have have another issue…. He will be my go to tow service!!

reviews.author: Adam Reinhold
reviews.text: Josh was there quickly and did a wonderful job getting my truck home. He even helped push it into the garage. Great service.

reviews.author: james edmundson
reviews.text: Towing guy was nice but they charged me $225 to tow a car 5 minutes in Holly Springs. The tow truck guy had just finished a tow 2 minutes away from where my car was and then towed my car 5 minutes to my house. Should've been $100-125 but since the police called the tow truck for me, the price jumped up to $225. Absolutely ridiculous. I called and tried to get the manager to reduce it considering how close the driver was and the short distance but he didn't care and hung up on me.

reviews.author: Amy Blitchok
reviews.text: Total lifesaver. We were stuck on the side of the expressway 45 minutes from home. The driver was extremely helpful and courteous. He helped us work out the logistics of getting home and getting the Jeep to the dealership and honestly made the best out of a bad situation.

reviews.author: James N
reviews.text: The driver of one of this company’s tow trucks was driving down N Judd Parkway today in Holly Spring/Fuquay Varina like an animal. He was tailgating, speeding and driving recklessly. The windows were tinted so I couldn’t see his face, but he had on a black wristband on his left hand.

reviews.author: Angela Royal
reviews.text: We just got a tow from Mike and he came within minutes hooked my car up and got it home safely. Excellent service definitely 5 stars

reviews.author: Stephen Barbour
reviews.text: I had to use R&R for the second time this morning. The driver (I believe his name was Mike) showed up very quickly, had my car hooked up quickly, and had me back home in no time. I hate I had to use a tow service, but I'm glad when I did, it was R&R!

reviews.author: Nick Van Ess
reviews.text: My wife and I were in a tricky situation and R&R was the only local tow company to pick up the phone to help. That speaks volumes about their level of care. Extremely helpful folks who are willing to lend a hand.

reviews.author: A Cotten
reviews.text: Michael and the company did an excellent job with my vehicle. They were quick and professional. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Terence Smith
reviews.text: Excellent tow provider. Quick fast professional service. I called and they came out in less than 30 minutes. Thank you Mike!!!!

reviews.author: Julie McDaniel
reviews.text: The driver who picked up my son’s wrecked car last week was rude and unprofessional. Although I was only moving at about 5 mph, apparently I didn’t move over far enough for his liking, so he screamed and cursed at me. I will never use their services again!

reviews.author: Tammy W
reviews.text: Towed our car from accident scene and even took photos of the scene to send to us while we were carried away by ambulance. Professionally handled all aspects of the storage and releasing of our vehicle to expedite the Insurance process. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Bill Farley
reviews.text: Chuck is the man! He is always quick to respond when we’re in need. You’re always in good hands with R&R Towing! Plus Chuck drives the big sexy truck!

reviews.author: Paola Pilo
reviews.text: Daniel is great! I called very late in the evening. My Tahoe was safe and soundly delivered to my mechanic. Quick response and friendly. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Joey Dominick
reviews.text: Will never do business with this company. Watched a truck with this company's logo on it drive like a psychopath through rush hour traffic in downtown Cary. Tailgating, honking, insane lane switches, the whole nine yards. Watched the drive like a 17 year old that just removed the muffler from a Civic. This is the only interaction I've had with this company, and I'm praying it's the last since the only time I'll see them again is in the road, I just hope they're nowhere near me.

reviews.author: Arlone Macatangay
reviews.text: Kyle was great, very helpful, and quick driver. Definitely a superhero who saved the day, and on a Sunday I might add.

reviews.author: Mike Solo
reviews.text: Noone wants to get stranded in a target parking lot at 10 at night. AAA said they could save me the next day but RR was there to pick me up in 20 minutes

reviews.author: Brandon Erickson
reviews.text: They were great! Picked up my jeep pretty quick and the driver Alex was great to work with. Will certainly be using them again

reviews.author: Scott Baltz
reviews.text: We did some extensive work with R&R. Both Rob and Amy were very helpful and knowledgeable. Things could not gone smoother and I will highly recommend them to anyone I can.

reviews.author: jim greene
reviews.text: Thank for your help Sunday night. Josh did a great job and he was very respectful and understanding.

reviews.author: Travis Menges
reviews.text: R&R has always provided professional and courteous service. They have always dispatched trucks immediately when I have needed their service. They are always my go to in an emergency situation. Thanks R&R!

reviews.author: Laura Blauser
reviews.text: My son's car died at 10pm in holly springs. I called R&R and Mike came right out to pick up the car. He was very professional and friendly.

reviews.author: steeleholls11
reviews.text: The guy was friendly enough, but he charged me $200 cash only just for getting me out of a ditch. And he didn't have to take me anywhere. Definitely ripped off probably because I am a woman.

reviews.author: Jimmy Baughan
reviews.text: My alternator recently died and I needed to get my truck home. They were very fast and very professional. Absolutely no complaints and highly reccomend their service.

reviews.author: Kate
reviews.text: Professional, efficient & respectful. My truck was towed there by the police after a wreck. I'm an older woman & when I went over there to clean out my personal stuff, they went out of their way to help me out. Thanks!

reviews.author: moon man
reviews.text: Didn't really seem like nice people at all. Spouce wrecked her car and wanted to collect personal effects and paper work out of vehicle that was towed. Alot of extra hassle for no reason. Would not recommend r&r at all. "Diesel fuel aint cheap"

reviews.author: Jason Williams
reviews.text: I've had two great experiences with R & R Towing. I highly recommend them as both experiences were top notch.

reviews.author: Brooke Canady
reviews.text: If you ever need towing R&R is the best! The staff is amazing, communication is great, and they will take great care of you!!!

reviews.author: April Giuliani
reviews.text: They are the best fast professional and take great care of the vehicle being towed actually take extremely great care of vehicle being towed . Thanks alot for your service . Best towing company!!!

reviews.author: David Schmidt
reviews.text: Fair priced. They had some one on a wreck b4 me but followed up quickly. Had my truck at home within 2hrs.

reviews.author: Conrí Gill
reviews.text: They said it would take 20 minutes but it took over an hour to get to me, but when they got here the service was quick and easy. Billy was great.

reviews.author: Rupal Tariq
reviews.text: My car was towed by R&R and Mr. Daniel was very helpful. Mr. Rob also worked with us in really difficult times.

reviews.author: Garrett May
reviews.text: This same saved my day! Was getting gas at a sheets and stupidly left my keys in my truck. Thankfully, R&R towing was in the pull next to me and had the gear to help me out. Thank you!!

reviews.author: We Haul Movers
reviews.text: The guys at R&R get back to you within an hour if they don't pick up right away. Very friendly people

reviews.author: Rho Rho
reviews.text: They have good service unitl they damage my garage waited a whole week for them to fix it but they actually didn't fix it , did it myself ..

reviews.author: Christopher Dunston
reviews.text: I was told I called the towing side and that someone from the storage side would call me. I never got the call back.

reviews.author: Erika Flynn
reviews.text: Josh has saved us twice now! Super friendly, timely and respectful. Would use R&R in the future as my first call.

reviews.author: Justin Crawford
reviews.text: Great, fast service! Helped us out in a pinch and quickly! Great communication throughout the process as well.
